justification: Restore constraint-arithmetic parity to the streaming Intelligence Brief. The capacity headline (realistic yield / binding constraint / #500 DCP-adjusted GFA) was computed and attached in the non-streaming brief path but had drifted out of the streaming path that the live UI consumes, so the flagship per-address brief silently lacked it on the live path.

pre_impl.existing_data: The streaming path already builds dcp_controls, sepp_housing, sepp_lep_overrides, planning_controls and has lot_area_m2 + controls in scope before the DevelopmentBrief build, so constraint arithmetic needs no new fetch — it reuses inputs already present, mirroring the non-streaming path.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed both brief endpoints were equivalent; they were not. compute_constraint_arithmetic appeared only in run_intelligence_brief, never in _generate_brief_sse — classic dual-path drift on the most important feature.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new logic invented: the streaming path now runs the same compute_constraint_arithmetic call, same dev_type and inputs, yields a constraint_arithmetic SSE section, and attaches the field to its DevelopmentBrief — identical to the non-streaming path.

functions.name: _generate_brief_sse
functions.input: the IntelligenceBriefRequest plus resolved prop_id, latitude, longitude and lot well-known-text
functions.output: a stream of SSE section events now including a constraint_arithmetic capacity section
functions.if_none: when lot_area_m2 is missing or zero the constraint section is skipped and the field stays None

values: N/A - no regulatory values hardcoded; reuses compute_constraint_arithmetic which reads the DCP/SEPP/LEP values already fetched earlier in the same streaming path
queries: N/A - no new database queries; the constraint computation reuses dcp_controls, sepp_housing and sepp_lep_overrides already fetched upstream in the streaming path

break_it.scenario: The constraint arithmetic computation raises an exception mid-stream
break_it.what_happens: Without isolation it would terminate the SSE stream and the user would lose the whole brief
break_it.how: the computation is wrapped in try/except that logs a warning and leaves constraint_field None; the brief continues and still completes

break_it.scenario: An apartment/strata address reaches the streaming assembly
break_it.what_happens: constraint_field could be referenced where it was never defined, raising NameError
break_it.repro: run the streaming brief for an is_apartment address
break_it.how: the constraint block and the DevelopmentBrief that reads constraint_field are both gated on not is_apartment; apartments build a RenovationBrief that does not reference it

break_it.scenario: Adding a section throws the progress percentage off (exceeds 100)
break_it.what_happens: Progress bar overshoots because total_sections did not count the new section
break_it.repro: stream a development brief and watch the emitted progress values
break_it.how: total_sections raised from +3 to +4 for the non-apartment case and the max-estimate from +3 to +4, so progress stays bounded

post_merge.manual_verify: Stream a development address (e.g. Penrith/Haberfield house) via /intelligence-brief/stream and confirm a constraint_arithmetic section event arrives. Play A (population context) is the subsequent follow-up. Dual-path unification remains the documented root-cause refactor.
